description: Schema for the GitLab secret detection scan profile configuration

secure_analyzers_prefix.description: Prefix for the container registry from which the analyzer image is pulled.

image_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the analyzer image name.

historic_scan.description: Whether to scan the full git history instead of only the current state.

log_options.description: Options passed to git log to control the commit range scanned.

excluded_paths.description: Glob paths excluded from the scan.

ruleset_git_reference.description: Git reference of the remote ruleset configuration to use.
